riskRegister.description: RLS/API authorization gap exposes farm data.
riskRegister.mitigation: RLS tests, farm_id enforcement, admin audit.

riskRegister.description: Unauthorized update changes income/profit.
riskRegister.mitigation: RBAC, transaction RPCs, audit, reconciliation.

riskRegister.description: Uploaded file abuses parser/storage.
riskRegister.mitigation: MIME validation, size limits, private bucket, malware scan readiness.

riskRegister.description: User input attempts unauthorized tool/data access.
riskRegister.mitigation: Tool allowlist, permission checks, no raw SQL, output filtering.

riskRegister.description: Service role/OpenAI/OCR keys exposed to client or logs.
riskRegister.mitigation: Server-only env vars, secret scanning, rotation.

riskRegister.description: Brute force or reused credentials.
riskRegister.mitigation: Password policy, PIN lockout, rate limiting, audit.

riskRegister.description: Privileged action suspends/deletes wrong farm.
riskRegister.mitigation: Confirmation, reason, protected action logs, least privilege.

riskRegister.description: Backup file leaks complete farm data.
riskRegister.mitigation: Private bucket, signed URLs, encryption, access audit.

riskRegister.description: Sensitive data appears in OS notification panel.
riskRegister.mitigation: Payload minimization and user preferences.

riskRegister.description: Generated report accessible publicly.
riskRegister.mitigation: Signed URLs, expiry, RLS metadata check.

riskRegister.description: Package vulnerability exploited.
riskRegister.mitigation: SCA, patch SLAs, CI checks.

riskRegister.description: Lost/invalid session causes broken navigation.
riskRegister.mitigation: Session validation, graceful login redirect, device QA.

riskRegister.description: OCR slips, reports or backups become publicly readable.
riskRegister.mitigation: Private-by-default buckets, CI policy checks, signed URL tests.

riskRegister.description: Server API using service role omits explicit farm authorization.
riskRegister.mitigation: Central auth guard, farm access assertion, code review checklist.

riskRegister.description: Stack traces or provider errors reveal internals to user.
riskRegister.mitigation: Safe error mapping, server-only logs, localized generic messages.

riskRegister.description: Broadcast sends sensitive or misleading content to wrong farms.
riskRegister.mitigation: Audience preview, send confirmation, delivery audit and RBAC.

riskRegister.description: Ticket attachments are exposed across farms/users.
riskRegister.mitigation: Ticket-scoped private storage and signed URL authorization.

riskRegister.description: Fallback messages expose technical details in English/Marathi.
riskRegister.mitigation: Central i18n error catalog and QA language sweep.

riskRegister.description: Queued offline writes overwrite newer financial/animal records.
riskRegister.mitigation: Conflict detection, server timestamps and user confirmation.

riskRegister.description: Supabase realtime sends farm notifications to unauthorized clients.
riskRegister.mitigation: Channel authorization and farm-scoped subscriptions.

aiRisks.mitigation: Use tool-only database retrieval; cite period/source in answer.

aiRisks.description: AI uses milk/slip/animal data without permission.
aiRisks.mitigation: Server-side AI permission checks before tool execution.

aiRisks.description: User asks model to bypass policy/tool limits.
aiRisks.mitigation: Instruction hierarchy, tool allowlist, schema validation.

aiRisks.description: AI logs retain private data too long.
aiRisks.mitigation: Retention policy, deletion, redaction and access limits.
Rate limits, quotas, short context and monitoring.
